title: Ex-President Duterte’s lawyers seek info on witnesses, victims

blocks.text: Lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte in the International Criminal Court (ICC) are seeking access to what they consider exculpatory material, particularly information regarding “criminal antecedents of all witnesses and victims,” to dispute allegations that police officers killed drug suspects outright and not for self-defense.
